newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGB futures likely to test new highs.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGB futures likely to test new highs.

text.p: Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to maintain a bullish tone in Tokyo on Thursday after Wednesday's bull-run, traders said.
The key December contract may test 126.52, the all-time high for any benchmark futures contract set on November 6, they said.

Wednesday's rally was fuelled by a set of factors, including the Bank of Japan's "tankan" survey of corporate sentiment, a fall in the key three-month certificates of deposit (CD) rate, and the prospect of more yen bond investments by Japan's major life insurance companies.
A change in the benchmark futures contract could take place during the day, traders said.
On Wednesday, the volumes of the December and March contracts were 58,416 and 23,375 contracts respectively.

Japan's October industrial production data is to be released at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT). Economists polled by Reuters on average forecast a rise of 3.5 percent month-on-month, compared with a revised 1.5 percent rise in September.
Traders said the market had already factored in strong growth in October production.
